Company profit/loss 35 and relevant balance-sheet accounts 25 correspond on paper 4 with the same ordinary/preference capital, dividends, reserves, interest and tax. English scheme 6.
The complete tabular statement is one 60-mark task on paper 5; all eight January transactions and closing totals correspond. English scheme 7.
Dental-practice opening capital 20 and income/expenditure 40 correspond on paper 6, including medical-card arrears and depreciation adjustments. English scheme 8.

Incomplete-record capital 10, combined sales/purchases control accounts 20, trading/profit-and-loss 30 and balance sheet 40 correspond on paper 12. Both control accounts are required within the shared tariff. English scheme 13–15.

Marginal-cost price 10, variable cost 10, contribution 10, break-even 10, safety margin 15, revised statement 20 and shared fixed-cost meaning/two examples 5 correspond on paper 13. The examples are open; both revised assumptions are mandatory. English scheme 16.

The five-month March–July cash budget 75 and two open useful-information points 5 correspond on paper 14, with all credit timings, April cash purchases, rent increase and equipment purchase retained. English scheme 17. Paper 15–16 explicitly contain no examination material.
